tree.title: Annual Report 2026
tree.summary:
Annual Report 2026

• Overview — physical pages 2–4. Pages 2–3 report Acme’s 2026 revenue of 120 million USD and net profit of 12 million USD, covering domestic operations only and excluding subsidiaries. Results on physical page 4 report Acme’s 2025 revenue of 100 million USD and net profit of 9 million USD; these are audited domestic-only totals.

• Results — physical pages 4–6. Reports Acme’s 2025 revenue of 100 million USD and net profit of 9 million USD as audited domestic-only totals. The figures and qualification are repeated across these pages, including the Appendix beginning on physical page 6.

• Annual Report 2026 (opening page) — physical page 1. Reports 2026 revenue of 120 million USD and net profit of 12 million USD, limited to domestic operations and excluding subsidiaries.

The Overview and Results sections share physical page 4; the summaries do not establish that both sections’ year-specific facts coexist on that page.

tree.title: Annual Report 2026
tree.summary: Navigation coverage: physical pages 1–21. Physical page 1 reports Acme’s 2026 revenue of 120 million USD and net profit of 12 million USD, limited to domestic operations and excluding subsidiaries. Section “1 Overview” covers pages 2–11 and reports the same 2026 totals with the same scope; pages 2–9 contain this coverage, and page 10 also reports the totals. Section “2 Results” covers pages 11–21 and reports Acme’s 2025 audited domestic-only financial results: revenue of 100 million USD and net profit of 9 million USD. These 2025 figures and qualification are reported on pages 11–18 and repeated on pages 19–21. Page 21 also includes an “Appendix” heading and repeats the 2025 results. Sections 1 Overview and 2 Results share physical page 11; the summaries do not establish that both sections’ facts coexist on that page.

tree.title: 1 Overview

Page 10 also reports those 2026 totals with the same scope. Page 11, headed “2 Results,” reports 2025 revenue of 100 million USD and net profit of 9 million USD, described as audited domestic-only totals.

tree.title: 2 Results

The figures are reported for pages 11–18 and repeated on pages 19–21, with the audited domestic-only qualification preserved. Page 21 also includes an “Appendix” heading and repeats the same results.

tree.title: 1 Operating Results
tree.summary: “1 Operating Results” (physical pages 1–24) covers Acme’s domestic revenue and net profit in USD for 2026 and 2025. Pages 1–9 and the overlapping 9–11 navigation section report 2026 revenue of 120 million USD and net profit of 12 million USD, limited to domestic operations and excluding subsidiaries. “Regional Operating Details” begins on page 11, but that page provides no distinct regional breakdown. Within its pages 11–13 coverage, pages 11–12 state the 2026 figures and subsidiary exclusion; page 13 instead reports 2025 revenue of 100 million USD and net profit of 9 million USD, explicitly identified as audited domestic-only totals. The pages 13–17 and 17–24 navigation sections repeat those audited 2025 domestic figures; they are not global totals. Adjacent navigation ranges overlap at boundary pages.

tree.title: 2026 Domestic Operating Results: Revenue and Net Profit
tree.summary: Pages 1–9 cover Acme’s 2026 domestic operating results: revenue of 120 million USD and net profit of 12 million USD. The figures apply to domestic operations only and exclude subsidiaries. The section begins with “1 Operating Results” on physical page 1; pages 1–8 repeat the results and scope qualification, and physical page 9 also reports these figures with the same qualification.

tree.title: 2026 Domestic Operating Results
tree.summary: Pages 9–11 report Acme’s 2026 revenue of 120 million USD and net profit of 12 million USD. The figures cover domestic operations only and exclude subsidiaries. These figures and the scope qualification are repeated throughout the section. Page 11 includes the heading “Regional Operating Details,” but provides no distinct regional breakdown.

tree.title: Regional Operating Details
tree.summary: Regional Operating Details (physical pages 11–13) reports Acme’s domestic financial results in USD. Pages 11–12 state 2026 revenue of 120 million USD and net profit of 12 million USD; coverage is domestic operations only, excluding subsidiaries. Page 13 reports 2025 revenue of 100 million USD and net profit of 9 million USD, explicitly described as audited domestic-only totals.

tree.title: 2025 Audited Domestic Operating Results
tree.summary: 2025 Audited Domestic Operating Results (physical pages 13–17). Repeated audited domestic-only figures state: “Acme 2025 revenue was 100 million USD.” and “Acme 2025 net profit was 9 million USD.” The figures are for 2025 and are denominated in USD.

tree.title: Acme 2025 Audited Domestic Revenue and Net Profit
tree.summary: Physical pages 17–24 repeatedly state Acme’s audited domestic-only totals for 2025: revenue of 100 million USD and net profit of 9 million USD. This section covers domestic results only, not global totals.

tree.title: Annual Report 2026
tree.summary: Annual Report 2026 covers Acme’s domestic operations only, excluding subsidiaries. Physical page 1 reports 2026 revenue of 120 million USD and net profit of 12 million USD. “1 Overview” has navigation coverage on pages 2–11: the supplied summary for pages 2–9 reports the same 2026 figures and scope qualification, and page 10 also reports them. Page 11 is headed “2 Results” and reports audited domestic-only totals for 2025: revenue of 100 million USD and net profit of 9 million USD. “2 Results” spans pages 11–20 and covers those 2025 results, including the continuation on pages 19–20. Page 11 is a shared navigation boundary; its explicitly reported figures are for 2025, not 2026.

tree.title: 1 Overview

The summary for pages 2–9 reports Acme’s 2026 revenue of 120 million USD and net profit of 12 million USD, covering domestic operations only and excluding subsidiaries; these figures and the scope qualification are repeated throughout that section. Page 10 also reports those 2026 figures with the same scope. Page 11, headed “2 Results,” reports 2025 revenue of 100 million USD and net profit of 9 million USD, described as audited domestic-only totals.

tree.title: 2 Results

tree.title: Acme 2026 Domestic Operations: Revenue and Net Profit
tree.summary: Pages 1–9 cover Acme’s 2026 domestic operations, reporting revenue of 120 million USD and net profit of 12 million USD. The figures explicitly exclude subsidiaries. Pages 1–8 repeat these figures, and physical page 9 reports the same amounts and scope.

tree.title: Acme 2026 domestic operations: revenue and net profit
tree.summary: Pages 9–12 report Acme’s 2026 revenue of 120 million USD and net profit of 12 million USD, covering domestic operations only and excluding subsidiaries. Page 13 provides audited domestic-only totals for 2025: revenue of 100 million USD and net profit of 9 million USD.

tree.title: Acme 2025 audited domestic totals: revenue and net profit

tree.title: Acme 2025 audited domestic revenue and net profit
tree.summary: Pages 17–25 cover Acme’s audited domestic-only financial totals for 2025: revenue of 100 million USD and net profit of 9 million USD.
